Australian security leaders are under growing pressure, with a new Proofpoint report highlighting that local CISOs face a significant resourcing gap as they manage increasing AI-related risks. Separately, a new phishing technique using "blob URLs" has been spotted targeting Microsoft browser users — these attacks are harder to detect because the malicious content is generated locally in the browser rather than from an external website. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source users should also be aware of a newly disclosed vulnerability that could affect online stores.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation runs an Adobe Commerce or Magento-based website, check with your web team or vendor today to confirm the latest security patches have been applied.
